This integer need not remain consistent from one execution of an application to another execution of the same application.
L4166:   * If two objects are equal according to the `equals` method, then calling the `hashCode` method on each of the two objects must produce the same integer result.
L4167:   * It is not required that if two objects are unequal according to the `equals` method, then calling the `hashCode` method on each of the two objects must produce distinct integer results. However, the programmer should be aware that producing distinct integer results for unequal objects may improve the performance of hash tables.

L2076: ### adoptShellPermissionIdentity
L2077: 
L2078: Added in 【54†API level 29】
L2079: 
L2080:     public void adoptShellPermissionIdentity ()
L2081: Adopt the permission identity of the shell UID for all permissions. This allows you to call APIs protected permissions which normal apps cannot hold but are granted to the shell UID. If you already adopted all shell permissions by calling this method or `【74†adoptShellPermissionIdentity(String...)】` a subsequent call will replace any previous adoption. Note that your permission state becomes that of the shell UID and it is not a combination of your and the shell UID permissions.
L2082: Note: Calling this method adopts all shell permissions and overrides any subset of adopted permissions via `【74†adoptShellPermissionIdentity(String...)】`.
L2083:

L2160: Executes a command and waits for a specific accessibility event up to a given wait timeout. To detect a sequence of events one can implement a filter that keeps track of seen events of the expected sequence and returns true after the last event of that sequence is received.
